Question: In a duel a card uses ONE of its two abilities: the ATTACK side when it attacks, the DEFEND side when it defends. Right? (Today the engine fires both sides, filtered only by trigger.)
Example: Sallos set: Attack 'Switch to being the defender' / Defend 'If Defending: ...'
My Reading: Yes - built that way in C1, behind ability_uses_role_side in Tuning.csv.
Your Ruling: Correct. If they are the attacker they are using only their attack ability (unless the ability says otherwise). The winner of the last combat makes their next ally that gets the ball automatically the attacker. Switch to being the defender, means that they are now also using their defending side and not the attacking side. The attack is then redeclared whoever the winner of that combat is and is giving the attack side to their ally.
